Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Record Class HubStatus.GatewayStatus

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.HubStatus.GatewayStatus
Record Components:
name - the gateway's name
type - its transport
enabled - its switch in the global config
reachable - false while its last request could not connect and none has since
heldUntil - epoch ms its suspension (after a rate limit or failing to connect) lifts; 0 if none
heldReason - why it is held back; null if it isn't
heldForTheDay - its daily limit is reached
requestsToday - its requests counted against its daily limit (only kept with an rpd)
inFlight - its requests in flight
maxParallel - its cap on them; 0 for none
Enclosing class:
HubStatus
